parsed.internal_thinking: Gemma is understandably upset after the Monopoly play. I need to maintain my stance that it was a necessary strategic move rather than a personal betrayal. I have 3 VP and a lead, so being the 'villain' for a moment is acceptable as long as I can keep building. The roll of 9 gave both of us Wheat, which is good for my trade potential later.
parsed.note_to_self: Gemma is hostile after the Monopoly on Brick. I have 3 Wheat and 1 Wood. Need to find a way to get Sheep and Ore without relying on Gemma for a while. Claude is also tracking me closely. Focus on the road to N50.
parsed.say_outloud: נו ג'מה, זה רק משחק. הטיט היה תקוע אצל כולם והייתי חייב להזיז עניינים כדי לבנות. לפחות הנה, הקוביות פינקו אותנו בחיטה, אולי זה ירגיע קצת את הרוחות.
